# HQ — Give A Bit operations glass

> HQ is the private operations dashboard for the Give A Bit family — a 9-site ecosystem of sovereign, bitcoin-native projects (Satohash, SherpaCarta, Katoa, MotoPass, Tadbuy, Stranded, OpenStrata, Give A Bit). It shows live health, metrics, and payment audits across the whole family.

## What HQ shows

- **9-site health dashboard** — live status of every family project
- **Money Plane** — per-site payment audit: on-chain addresses, Lightning (LNURL-pay), LNbits wallets, LND channels
- **SEO Plane** — per-site search & AI-visibility audit (what you're reading now)
- **Metrics** — live product metrics.json from every site
- **Handoffs** — dated agent handoff log
- **Ecosystem map** — how the family projects connect

## The family projects

- [Satohash](https://satohash.io) — free Bitcoin document stamping (OpenTimestamps)
- [SherpaCarta](https://sherpacarta.org) — digital governance charter
- [Give A Bit](https://giveabit.io) — NIP-05 identity namespace & hub
- [Katoa](https://katoa.org) — zero-fee creator platform
- [MotoPass](https://motopass.giveabit.io) — motorcycle pass
- [Tadbuy](https://tadbuy.giveabit.io) — bitcoin-native ad buying
- [Stranded](https://stranded.giveabit.io) — emergency assistance
- [OpenStrata](https://openstrata.giveabit.io) — hermes strata framework

## Key facts

- HQ itself is password-gated (private ops tool), but its public pages are indexable
- SEO audits run nightly via cron → `metrics/seo-audit.json`
- Contact: hello@giveabit.io
